findings: All nine desktop station plot pairs and their visible values were inspected. The selected scattering vectors now preserve the stated angle with equal physical gains.
The particle/antiparticle chart displays the distinct opposite-charge points at equal positive excitation energy; negative classical branch markers remain separate.
The explicit logarithmic Compton, Casimir and static-potential charts retain labelled axes and selected markers. Signed attractive values remain in the visible exact ledgers/readouts.
The rate branch displays a declared rate-percentage chart, and the magnetic station labels its first-loop scope.

Representative modes, scattering and Casimir 3D views were inspected at both widths. The categorical contribution graph and scalar mode-factor surface remain distinct from physical trajectories/full vector EM fields.
Selected mobile panel captures show chart titles below the sticky header and legible readouts, without apparent page overflow in the inspected frames.
limits: 24 of 54 capture pixels were visually inspected. All 54 files had hashes and native PNG dimensions independently checked, but the other 30 were not individually visually inspected.
The screenshots capture one viewport position, not the whole vertically scrollable lesson. Some ledger rows and the complete 3D calibration readout are below the visible region.
Mobile ledger columns use horizontal scrolling; a single capture does not display every column simultaneously.
The selected mobile antiparticle review uses panel 1 to inspect the physical excitation points. Its full eigenvalue-branch pair was inspected on desktop.
Captured 3D perspective and label placement do not themselves certify physical distances; calibrated source coordinates and gains were separately checked by independent numerical oracles.
Interactive-flow counts come from the pinned owner receipt. This reviewer did not independently create another authenticated browser session or repeat every interaction.
This is isolated local reader evidence, not a deployment, production or whole-Primer approval.
